description:
"For someone who seduced me so boldly, that's a rather innocent reaction. I've been burning for you since midday - I thought it would be the death of me."  
"S-seduced? Hngh!"

The man's thick lips swallowed Seon-a's.   
Through her lips, parted in surprise, his hot tongue pushed in and swept through her mouth.  
She couldn't breathe, couldn't think - she was on the verge of losing her mind entirely.  
Seon-a couldn't tell whether this was a kiss or whether she was being devoured by him.  
Above all, she had no idea why any of this was happening.  
The man kept stroking her body over the thin fabric.   
His palms were so big and so hot that everywhere they passed felt like it caught fire.  

"Surely the real thing is far better than a fake?"
